<div class="card-body">
'''R-3PO (Ar-Threepio)''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Droid]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">R-3PO (アー・スリーピオ)</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">各ターンに1回、自分の支配フェイズに、同じ場所にいる相手のスパイ1名ごとに相手は1フォースを失う。失うフォースは、スパイがドロイドか潜伏中なら2、両方であるなら4に増える。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-R-3PO-Ar-Threepio-PSA-86099779.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">帝国軍の秘密工作ドロイドに対抗するべく設計された。ドロイド置き場を頻繁に往来し、潜伏中のスパイの正体を暴く。左のお尻には“メーカーに感謝”の文字が刻まれている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' R-3PO (Ar-Threepio).

'''Card text:'''
Once each turn during your control phase, opponent loses 1 Force for each opponent’s spy at the same place. That loss is 2 if the spy is a droid or undercover, or 4 if both.

'''Lore:'''
Designed to counter Imperial espionage droids. It often visits the droid pool and uncovers undercover spies. “Thank the Maker” is engraved on its left buttocks.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is 通訳用ドロイド.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[R-3PO (Ar-Threepio)]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
